name: io.github.formatho.runtime
description: Private, self-hosted MCP tool infrastructure for AI agents. Deterministic developer, security, and EVM tools (JSON, hashing, JWT decode, keccak, function selectors, CREATE2, storage slots, calldata decode, EIP-55, ERC-4626 math, Uniswap v4 permissions) with a permissioned tool registry, per-agent policy engine, and metadata-only audit logging. Tools are pure functions with zero network, filesystem, or secret access. Runs on-premise via Docker; your agents' payloads never leave your infrastructure.

tools.name: formatho.registry
tools.description: Registry metadata with per-tool permissions and verification status

tools.name: jwt.decode
tools.description: Decode JWT header and claims (no signature verification)

tools.name: evm.function_selector
tools.description: Signature to 4-byte selector with reverse lookup

tools.name: evm.decode_calldata
tools.description: Selector match and static argument decode

tools.name: evm.v4_hook_permissions
tools.description: Uniswap v4 hook permission bits encode/decode
